arxiv-2012-08338.title: Asymptotic Behavior of Free Energy When Optimal Probability Distribution Is Not Unique
arxiv-2012-08338.creator: Shuya Nagayasu, Sumio Watanabe
arxiv-2012-08338.description: Abstract Bayesian inference is a widely used statistical method. The free energy and generalization loss, which are used to estimate the accuracy of Bayesian inference, are known to be small in singular models that do not have a unique optimal parameter. However, their characteristics are not yet known when there are multiple optimal probability distributions.

arxiv-2303-01718.title: Two Problems on Narayana Numbers And Repeated Digit Numbers
arxiv-2303-01718.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . This work aims to solve two problems in Diophantine equation of the Narayana sequence ( O ​ E ​ I ​ S ​ A ​ 000930 ) (OEIS{\color[rgb]{1,0,0}A000930}) . In the first part it’s proved that the Narayana number can not be factored as a product of two repdigit numbers for base 2 ≤ b ≤ 50 2\leq b\leq 50 , except in two cases.

arxiv-2306-07696.title: Crossed Andreev reflection and elastic co-tunneling in a three-site Kitaev chain nanowire device
arxiv-2306-07696.creator: Alberto Bordin, Xiang Li, David van Driel, Jan Cornelis Wolff, Qingzhen Wang, Sebastiaan L. D. ten Haaf, Guanzhong Wang, Nick van Loo, Leo P. Kouwenhoven, Tom Dvir
arxiv-2306-07696.description: Abstract The formation of a topological superconducting phase in a quantum-dot-based Kitaev chain requires nearest neighbor crossed Andreev reflection and elastic co-tunneling. Here we report on a hybrid InSb nanowire in a three-site Kitaev chain geometry — the smallest system with well-defined bulk and edge — where two superconductor-semiconductor hybrids separate three quantum dots.

arxiv-2310-08155.title: Spatially resolved radio signatures of electron beams in a coronal shock
arxiv-2310-08155.creator: Peijin Zhang, Diana Morosan ,, Anshu Kumari, Emilia Kilpua
arxiv-2310-08155.description: Abstract Context. Type II radio bursts are solar radio burst associated with coronal shocks. Type II bursts usually exhibit fine structures in dynamic spectra that represent signatures of accelerated electron beams. So far, the sources of individual fine structures in type II bursts have not been spatially resolved in high-resolution low-frequency radio imaging. Aims.

arxiv-2311-07902.title: Numerical analyses of the flow past a short rotating cylinder
arxiv-2311-07902.creator: Yongliang Yang 1,2, Chenglei Wang 3, Rui Guo 1, Mengqi Zhang 2
arxiv-2311-07902.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yongliang Yang 1,2, Chenglei Wang 3, Rui Guo 1, Mengqi Zhang 2. This work studies the three-dimensional flow dynamics around a rotating circular cylinder of finite length, whose axis is positioned perpendicular to the streamwise direction.

arxiv-2403-07531.title: How Language, Culture, and Geography shape Online Dialogue: Insights from Koo
arxiv-2403-07531.creator: Amin Mekacher 1 , Max Falkenberg 1 and Andrea Baronchelli 1,2,* 1 City University of London, Department of Mathematics, London EC1V 0HB, (UK) 2 The Alan Turing Institute, British Library, London NW1 2DB, (UK) * Corresponding author: abaronchelli@turing.ac.uk
arxiv-2403-07531.description: Abstract Koo is a microblogging platform based in India launched in 2020 with the explicit aim of catering to non-Western communities in their vernacular languages. With a near-complete dataset totalling over 71M posts and 399M user interactions, we show how Koo has attracted users from several countries including India, Nigeria and Brazil, but with variable levels of sustained user engagement.

arxiv-2405-17239.title: The Three Hundred project: Estimating the dependence of gas filaments on the mass of galaxy clusters
arxiv-2405-17239.creator: Sara Santoni, Marco De Petris, Gustavo Yepes, Antonio Ferragamo, Matteo Bianconi, Meghan E. Gray, Ulrike Kuchner, Frazer R. Pearce, Weiguang Cui, Stefano Ettori
arxiv-2405-17239.description: Abstract Context. Galaxy clusters are located in the densest areas of the universe and are intricately connected to larger structures through the filamentary network of the cosmic web. In this scenario, matter flows from areas of lower density to higher density.

arxiv-2505-11272.title: Resistivity of non-Galilean invariant two dimensional Dirac system
arxiv-2505-11272.creator: V. M. Kovalev, 1,2 M. V. Entin 1,3 , Z. D. Kvon, 1,3 A. D. Levin, 4 V. A. Chitta, 4 G. M. Gusev, 4 and N. N. Mikhailov 1,3
arxiv-2505-11272.description: Abstract We revisited the influence of electron-electron scattering on the resistivity of a two-dimensional system with a linear spectrum. In conventional systems with a parabolic spectrum, where Umklapp scattering is either prohibited or ineffective due to the small Fermi surface, particle-particle scattering does not contribute to conductivity because it does not change the total momentum.

arxiv-2505-14323.title: Securing Transfer-Learned Networks with Reverse Homomorphic Encryption Thanks: Equal contribution.
arxiv-2505-14323.creator: Robert Allison *, Tomasz Maciazek *, Henry Bourne
arxiv-2505-14323.description: Abstract The growing body of literature on training-data reconstruction attacks raises significant concerns about deploying neural network classifiers trained on sensitive data. However, differentially private (DP) training (e.g. using DP-SGD) can defend against such attacks with large training datasets causing only minimal loss of network utility.

arxiv-2506-14294.title: Uncertainty-Driven Radar-Inertial Fusion for Instantaneous 3D Ego-Velocity Estimation
arxiv-2506-14294.creator: Prashant Kumar Rai 1 , Elham Kowsari 1 , Nataliya Strokina 2 , Reza Ghabcheloo 1
arxiv-2506-14294.description: Abstract We present a method for estimating ego-velocity in autonomous navigation by integrating high-resolution imaging radar with an inertial measurement unit. The proposed approach addresses the limitations of traditional radar-based ego-motion estimation techniques by employing a neural network to process complex-valued raw radar data and estimate instantaneous linear ego-velocity along with its associated uncertainty.

arxiv-2507-15537.title: Matrix inversion polynomials for the quantum singular value transformation
arxiv-2507-15537.creator: Christoph Sünderhauf, Zalán Németh, Adnaan Walayat, Andrew Patterson, Bjorn K. Berntson
arxiv-2507-15537.description: Abstract Quantum matrix inversion with the quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) requires a polynomial approximation to 1 / x 1/x . Several methods from the literature construct polynomials that achieve the known degree complexity 𝒪 ⁡ ( κ ​ log ⁡ ( κ / ε ) ) \mathcal{O}(\kappa\log(\kappa/\varepsilon)) with condition number κ \kappa and uniform error ε \varepsilon .

pmc-10533868.creator: Melina Garcia Guizzo, Claudio Meneses, Pedro Amado Cecilio, Patricia Hessab Alvarenga, Daniel Sonenshine, Jose M Ribeiro

Since its first description, AMF has been under constant optimization and standardization for different tick species and life stages.

pmc-11356765.title: Biolaminates as an Example of Upcycling Product with Keratin Flour—Research and Thermal Properties Modeling
pmc-11356765.creator: Michał Frydrysiak, Philippe Evon
pmc-11356765.description: Keratin waste, including keratin powder, is a significant byproduct of the poultry processing and meat industries. It is a major contributor to waste management problems due to its volume and the environmental pollutants that it can produce. The disposal of keratin waste is challenging due to the potential for odors and pathogens to enter the soil and water.

pmc-11396189.title: Use of Traditional Japanese Herbal Medicine Daikenchuto for the Treatment of Abdominal Distention in Very-Low-Birth-Weight Infants
pmc-11396189.creator: Shigeo Iijima, Ulrich Herbert Thomé
pmc-11396189.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants often experience feeding intolerance owing to organ immaturity, and the most frequent sign is the presence of abdominal distention. Daikenchuto (DKT), a traditional Japanese herbal medicine, is used to improve gastrointestinal function, particularly in adults. The aim of this study was to investigate the effectiveness of DKT in reducing abdominal distention and intestinal gas in VLBW infants.

pmc-11525480.title: Light-induced rolling of azobenzene polymer thin films for wrapping subcellular neuronal structures
pmc-11525480.creator: Marta J I Airaghi Leccardi, Benoît X E Desbiolles, Anna Y Haddad, Baju C Joy, Chen Song, Deblina Sarkar
pmc-11525480.description: Neurons are essential cells composing our nervous system and orchestrating our body, thoughts, and emotions. Recently, research efforts have been focused on studying not only their collective structure and functions but also the single-cell properties as an individual complex system.

pmc-11644422.title: Leaf Aquaporin Expression in Grafted Plants and the Influence of Genotypes and Scion/Rootstock Combinations on Stomatal Behavior in Grapevines Under Water Deficit
pmc-11644422.creator: Andrea Galaz, Alonso G. Pérez-Donoso, Marina Gambardella
pmc-11644422.description: This study investigates the impact of water stress on grapevines, specifically examining the role of rootstocks and aquaporins. Two experiments on potted plants were conducted in central Chile during the summer, under conditions of high water demand, involving various rootstock genotypes and combinations of Cabernet Sauvignon (CS) grafted onto rootstocks.

pmc-11668644.title: Cranial volume measurement with artificial intelligence and cognitive scales in patients with clinically isolated syndrome
pmc-11668644.creator: Özlem Albuz, Ibrahim Acir, Ozan Haşimoğlu, Melis Suskun, Elif Hocaoğlu, Vildan Yayla
pmc-11668644.description: ObjectiveWe aimed to investigate the relationship between volumetric measurements of specific brain regions which were measured with artificial intelligence (AI) and various neuropsychological tests in patients with clinically isolated syndrome.Materials and methodsA total of 28 patients diagnosed with CIS were included in the study.

pmc-11727105.title: Comparison of Bone Marrow Biopsy and Flow Cytometry in Demonstrating Bone Marrow Metastasis of Neuroblastoma
pmc-11727105.creator: Esra Arslantaş, Ali Ayçiçek, Selvinaz Özkara, Ayşe Özkan Karagenç, Sibel Akpınar Tekgündüz, Duygu Yıldırgan, Tuba Nur Tahtakesen Güçer, Ayşe Gonca Kaçar, Özgü Hançerli, Saide Ertürk, Ezgi Paslı Uysalol, Cengiz Bayram, Giuseppe Ingravallo
pmc-11727105.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objective: This study aimed to compare bone marrow aspirate (BMA) multicolor flow cytometry (MFC) analysis and bone marrow biopsy (BMB) in detecting bone marrow (BM) involvement in children with neuroblastoma (NB) at diagnosis and during follow-up. Materials and Methods: A total of 132 BM samples from 39 patients (M/F ratio: 19/20; median age: 38 months) with neuroblastoma were simultaneously obtained for evaluation. The samples were investigated for BM involvement using BMB and MFC.

pmc-12664351.title: Effect of β-glucans with different molecular weights on pasting, rheological, texture properties, and in vitro digestibility of normal and waxy highland barley starches
pmc-12664351.creator: Xueqing Wang, Ruoqi Sun, Xuebing Wang, Xiangping Zhang, Shuoya Zeng, Jingjing Yang, Lang Jia, Jingfeng Li, Bei Fan, Jia Liu, Yatao Huang, Fengzhong Wang, Lili Wang
pmc-12664351.description: This study investigated the impact of low, medium, and high molecular weight β-glucans on physicochemical properties and in vitro digestibility of normal (NHBS) and waxy highland barley starches (WHBS). Results indicated that β-glucans with different molecular weights had varying effects on HBS properties.

pmc-13214425.title: EEG complexity analysis using enhanced entropy features for depression detection and severity classification
pmc-13214425.creator: Dorsa Mosleh Shirazi, Maryam Mohebbi, Yashar Abolfathi, Reza Rostami
pmc-13214425.description: BackgroundDepression is a psychological disorder characterized by persistent feelings of sadness, and questionnaires are commonly employed for the diagnose this condition and its associated symptoms. The identification of depression is critically important due to its potential to induce significant socioeconomic issues and long-lasting effects on the economy. However, utilizing questionnaires allow room for human error in their findings.

pmc-13632191.title: Impact of emotional intelligence and conflict management on workplace dynamics in Hossana Health Centers, Central Ethiopia
pmc-13632191.creator: Ashenafi Woldemichael Woime
pmc-13632191.description: BackgroundEmotional intelligence (EI), conflict management (CM), and performance effectiveness (WPE) are emerging areas of study in workplace dynamics in healthcare. Rural health centers in Ethiopia lack documented studies on these areas. This study aimed to analyze the correlation between emotional intelligence, conflict management, and workplace performance effectiveness among healthcare workers in Hossana Town, Central Ethiopia.
